title: Booked For You · पूरा शहर आपके नाम
logline: On Diwali night a 'SPACE AVAILABLE' hoarding is stamped BOOKED… for you, and then the rest of the city is booked too. MM's tri-vision, LED screen and LED van each roast a Diwali every family lives through: the safai, the Monday diet and soan papdi regifting. Then every ad switches off so one diya can pass its light to a red tower and on to every home. The lit city is stamped FULLY BOOKED with happiness, and three towers strung with lights snap into the MM mark. The card signs it 'Sponsored by: Aapke Apne · Media partner: MM Advertising', and a forward-the-light ticker ends on 'Sabko!'.
rationale: WHY PEOPLE FORWARD IT. (1) The forward is the media buy. The sender 'books the whole city' for one person, a grand gesture anyone can afford, and the card signs it for them ('Sponsored by: Aapke Apne'), so it reads as their own wish rather than an agency ad. By 1.47 s the hook is about the receiver ('for you / आपके लिए'). (2) Three short family truths that people can screenshot, one per bar, each with one hero line of 6 words or fewer held at least 1.85 s: 'घर साफ़। कमर हाफ़।', 'डाइट: मंडे से। काजू कतली: अभी से।' and 'सोन पापड़ी: आए 3, गए 4।'. People will tag the mom, the dieter and the regifter. Two fine-print easter eggs (*T&C: Mummy, *Box #4: a mystery) reward a pause and a replay. (3) Laughter turns to warmth. The ads go dark and 'मेरे दीये से, आपके दीये तक। / From my diya to yours.' makes it safe to send to parents, the boss and clients, and the forwarder becomes the 'my'. (4) The end card tells people who to send it to without chain-letter wording: 'Forward the light · रोशनी आगे बढ़ाइए' with a typed ticker (Mummy-Papa… Bestie… Boss… Pados wale uncle… Sabko!). (5) It reads as Diwali from frame 0 (a marigold toran, a lit diya on the catwalk and sky sparkles), and the misdirect pays off at 0.40 s. At 24.4 s it plays whole on WhatsApp Status and in an Instagram story. The last 0.3 s dims to the frame-0 night and the tubelight hum, so it loops cleanly into the hook. (6) It works pan-India from one master file. Devanagari hero lines each carry one English sub of 6 words or fewer, at least 40 px, that appears with the hero. A CUT-EN re-render (same timeline) swaps the hero and sub languages on S2–S5 for South, East and NRI groups. A variant pack re-renders only the S1 handwriting: 'for Mummy-Papa / for my bestie / for the team / for our clients'. HOW THE BRAND IS INTEGRATED. MM's own media are the cast and the joke: a classic hoarding, a tri-vision, an LED screen, and an LED van with the on-red mark on its MM Red cab door. Every board carries a media-owner plate, and the hook plate shows a 44 px reverse mark from frame 0. The Stamp Violet block-print stamp nods to the pre-1970 printing roots and drives the plot from BOOKED to FULLY BOOKED. The light passes from a diya to the MM Red middle tower first, and the red tower lights both sides. That plants 'the pillar between them belongs to both' 5 s before the three towers and two lantern-weighted light strings snap into the exact mark. The geometry is true: chevron notch at 34% and blunt tip at 73% of the mark's height, with the band meeting the pillars over the top 42%. The Legacy Line appears only as the balcony railing (one red pillar under the hero diya) and the end-card toran (one red pillar at x 540). A three-note sonic mark, D–A–D' with a bell doubling the middle red-pillar note, becomes MM's audio signature. MM is credited, not shouted: 'MEDIA PARTNER', the bilingual reverse lockup, and 'Trust, made visible.' MUST-FIXES APPLIED. Three gags (rangoli and relatives cut, soan papdi grafted onto the van). Six OOH sites in S2 and one reusable board rig. One hero line per gag. The jargon turn line replaced. Diwali cues in every scene. The S9 geometry is exact, with its clear space masked and no rocket launched from the mark. One lockup scale. Seven end-card elements. A frame-aligned 100 BPM grid: beat 0.600 s = 18 frames, offset 0.400 s, all times rounded to the nearest frame (round(t*30)/30). A phone-safe mix: every sub hit carries a 120–250 Hz body, with at most 2 SFX layers per beat during the gags. DELIVERY. H.264 High, yuv420p, 1080x1920, 30 fps, 5–6 Mbps (about 16 MB), AAC 192 kbps, +faststart, with grain and dither on the dark gradients so they survive WhatsApp re-encoding. Check every hero line on a real phone at 1x with the Story UI mocked over it.

art_direction.palette: Rich Black #1C1A1A: base night, ground, end-card background, and the halo behind the mark. Sky: vertical gradient from #25203F at the top (Rich Black + 25% Stamp Violet) to #1C1A1A. Ink #2B2728: buildings, board frames, media-owner plates, balcony railing, hero type on Muslin. Stone #8C8783: 2 px top-edge highlights, fine print on Muslin, the Face-A sale ad, 'MEDIA PARTNER'. Mist #C9C4BF: English subs on dark, forward label, tagline, cold home windows at 12%. Muslin #EEECE8: hoarding and tri-vision faces, Hindi heroes on dark, stamp knock-outs, soan papdi boxes, kaju katli. Paper #F4F2EE (L.PAL.paper, never blooms): heroes on dark, the reverse logo's outer parts, toran at 85%. MM Red #D2232E (the only red): the shared pillar (middle tower, railing pillar, toran pillar), one punch word per board ('हाफ़', 'काजू कतली: अभी से।', the '4'), FULLY BOOKED stamp ink, the matchstick, van cab, soan papdi ribbons, the middle rocket burst, 'for you' and the ticker. Stamp Violet #3F3593: BOOKED stamp ink on Muslin only, plus a faint sky haze. LIGHT ONLY, never on type or the logo: Diya Amber #FFB547, Marigold #F59E1B, Gold #FFC24A, Amber #FF9F1C, flame cores #FFE7A3 / #FFF4CF, cool tubelight #F4F6FF, and pure white #FFFFFF for bulb cores, sparks and firework heads (these bloom).
art_direction.style: Premium flat-geometric night city in 2.5D parallax, in five layers: sky and stars, far Lucknow silhouettes (a Rumi Darwaza-style gateway and a clock tower, secular and generic), mid buildings with window grids, near rooftops and street, foreground bokeh. Everything solid is built from the mark's own parts, equal pillars and V-chevrons: hoarding legs, tri-vision slats, LED bezel, van body, the Legacy-Line balcony railing, and light strings pulled into V's by lanterns. Flat fills with a 2 px Stone top-edge highlight. No outlines, no faces and no hands: the MM Red matchstick lights the diya by itself. Before animating, build a style kit (van, jhadu, kaju katli, soan papdi box, LED bezel, tri-vision, diya, akash kandil), review each item as a 0.5-scale still, and cut anything that reads as clip-art. Deliberate imperfection appears only on the stamps: block-print texture, with the wobble animated on twos. Camera grammar: pull-back (S1→S2); one lateral 'auto-rickshaw ride' with 8-frame whip-pans through the three gags (S3); a whip-up to the wide shot (S4); a held wide with a 4% push-in (S4–S5); a dolly-in (S6); settle (S7). Determinism: every particle, the kaju katli pile, the van suspension, the stamp spatter and the slat wave are either closed-form functions of t or tables pre-simulated at init from L.rnd seeds. No state is carried between frames. Draw the logo only through L.drawLogo or L.markParts, with uniform scale.
art_direction.typography: Anek Latin ('lat'), semi-expanded (wdth 112.5) unless noted. English heroes: weight 760 at 112 px ('Happy Diwali') and 78 px ('SPACE AVAILABLE', maxWidth 780). Stamp words: weight 760, expanded (wdth 125); 'BOOKED' 120 px (maxWidth 600), 'FULLY BOOKED' 80 px (maxWidth 700). English subs: weight 600, 40–46 px (S2 44, safai 44, kaju 40, van 40, turn 46, wish 44). Stamp band: weight 600, 40 px. Forward label: weight 600, 38 px. 'MEDIA PARTNER': weight 600, 30 px, tracking +6. Tagline + URL: weight 600, 32 px. Plates: weight 650, 28 px on the hook plate and 22 px on the gag boards. Fine print: weight 500, 28 px. 'MEGA SALE 50%': weight 760, 90 px. Anek Devanagari ('dev'): letter-spacing 0, never split into glyphs, animated per word only. Heroes: S1 76 px / weight 700; S2 84 / 700; safai 92 / 800; kaju line 1 72 / 700 and line 2 84 / 800; van label 60 / 700 and line 108 / 800; turn 92 / 700; wish 84 / 700; 'शुभ दीपावली' 104 / 700. Stamp bands: weight 600, 40–44 px. Forward label: weight 600, 40 px. Fine print: weight 500, 28 px. Tiro Devanagari Hindi italic ('tiro', weight 400, used in small doses): 'for you' 120 px, 'आपके लिए' 64 px, 'Sponsored by: Aapke Apne' 54 px, ticker 64 px. Rules: every L.text call gets a maxWidth, checked with L.measure; anything meant to be read is at least 36 px; 28 px fine print is for pausers only; each sub appears with its hero, never after it; one hero line per beat; all text inside x 90–990, y 260–1600.
art_direction.lighting_fx: The light tells a two-temperature story. S1–S3 are lit by commercial light: cool tubelight #F4F6FF cones, LED white and Muslin faces, with cold home windows (Mist 12%). Diwali is still present in every shot: a toran, diyas on catwalks and parapets, jhalar strings, and faint sky fireworks at 30%. At 12.400 every ad dies (MM.postParams exposure 1.00→0.82, no flash). From 13.000 the light is domestic and warm, spreading from the diya to the red tower and then across the city in 8th-note rings, with each window popping 1 frame overbright (x1.6) before settling. Finishing pass (engine/post.js): bloom only on pixels ≥247 (flames, bulb cores, firework heads, sparks); type uses Paper/Muslin so it never blooms. Halation on warm lights. About 3% grain (around 2 px) plus dither on every dark gradient so they survive WhatsApp re-encoding. Vignette 0.45. Real motion blur (4 sub-frames, 180° shutter) on whips, stamp drops and the dolly. Warm bloom only BEHIND copy (S4: radial #FFB547 at 18%) and behind the mark, never on it. A 60 px Rich Black halo keeps fireworks off copy and stamps, and the logo's clear-space box is masked for every particle. Photosensitivity: no full-frame flashes; impacts use shake plus shockwave rings, and the S6 flash is one low-intensity frame behind the mark. MM.postParams timeline: exposure 0.82 for 12.400–13.000, easing back to 1.00 by 13.600; exposure 1.06 for 3 frames at 16.000 and at 19.600; bloom +20% for 16.600–17.800.
art_direction.recurring_motifs: (1) The rubber stamp: Stamp Violet BOOKED (0.400, then 2.800–4.000 across the city) becomes the MM Red FULLY BOOKED (16.000). (2) The MM media-owner plate on every board from frame 0. (3) Pillars and V-chevrons everywhere: hoarding legs, tri-vision slats, the Legacy-Line balcony railing, lantern-weighted light strings, the toran. (4) The red pillar as the light-giver: an MM Red matchstick in pillar proportion (17.5:100), the red railing pillar under the hero diya, the red middle tower that lights first and holds both strings, the middle MM Red burst, and the MM Red 'for you' and ticker. (5) The address line moves from receiver to sender to everyone: 'for you' → 'Sponsored by: Aapke Apne' → 'Sabko!'. (6) Light passed on: diya → red tower → every home → strings → mark → 'Forward the light'. (7) Fine-print easter eggs. (8) Sonic motifs: stamp thuds pitched upward a semitone each time, a rising Yaman scale with every light, and the D–A–D' sonic mark with a bell on A for the red pillar.

audio.key_and_scale: Tonic D (Sa = D) with a Raag Yaman colour: D E F# G# A B C# D' (tivra Ma = G#), the evening lamp-lighting raga, festive without being devotional; tanpura on D–A. Grid: beat n falls at t = 0.400 + 0.600·n, i.e. 18 frames per beat at 30 fps, 9 frames per 8th note, and a 0.1 s (3-frame) sub-grid for fills and the tihai. Bars 1–5 start at 0.4, 2.8, 5.2, 7.6 and 10.0; bar 6 (12.4–16.0) is one 6/4 bar for the silent turn; bars 7–10 start at 16.0, 18.4, 20.8 and 23.2. Every cue and visual time is rounded to the nearest frame, round(t·30)/30.
audio.instrumentation: Synthesized in numpy (audio/synth.py), plus sampled GM instruments through fluidsynth (audio/sampler.py). Sampled: shehnai (the frame-0 pickup) and sitar with meend (the hook, the 'ta-daa', the tremolo). Synth: santoor (Karplus-Strong) for every light and the sonic mark; dhol (dhol_boom 68 Hz / dhol_tik) and tabla (na / tin / ge / ke) in a keherwa groove; shaker; clap; ghungroo; bell and chime (D5, A5, D6); tanpura (Sa = D); pad. SFX: tubelight hum and flicker; stamp thuds (sub_boom + 180 Hz body + wood knock + paper slap); flip_clack slats; whoosh; riser; 8-bit blips; bitcrush crumble; van putter, brake squeak and a two-tone horn tuned to D–A; woodblock toks; relay thunk and power-down whine; cricket; match_strike; flame whoomp; sparkler; firework_launch, firework_burst and crackle; pen scratch; ui_tap typing. Mix with Mix(dur 24.4): a short room reverb for 0–12.4 and a long hall from 13.0; every sub event doubled with a 120–250 Hz body so it carries on phone speakers; at most 2 SFX layers per beat in the gag section; SFX panned no wider than ±0.5; roll-off above 10 kHz; no voice; −14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP, mono-compatible.
audio.arc: 0.000: a shehnai pickup over the tubelight hum (a festive misdirect). 0.400: STAMP THUD on bar 1. Then sparse santoor under the handwriting, and a riser from 2.200. 2.800: the keherwa groove drops in with stamp cascades pitched up a semitone each and the Yaman sitar hook (Ni Re Ga Re Sa). 5.200–12.400: comic groove with one sting per gag: slat clack and back-crack; 8-bit blips, kaju katli pings and the crumble 'womp'; van putter, box toks, horn and box hops. 12.400: relay THUNK and dead silence, with one cricket. 12.700: the match. 13.000: tanpura and a rising Yaman scale, one note per ring of light from D5 to D6, over a heartbeat tabla, with a cricket for the late window. 15.400: riser. 16.000: mega stamp, the full groove, rockets and bursts. 17.400: a tabla tihai landing on the 18.400 CLACK, followed by 0.2 s of silence. 19.000: a launch chord D–A–D'. 19.600: triple burst with the groove opening up. 20.800: the sonic mark D5–A5 (with bell)–D6. Typing plucks rise to 'Sabko!' at 22.600. 23.200: one high bell, then the tanpura fades. 24.100: the tubelight hum returns (loop seam). 24.400: end.
